structured_output.rationale: All five lines carry CO-4 + N822. CARC 4 = required modifier missing; N822 = missing procedure modifier(s). CPTs 97110, 97140, 97530 are always-therapy codes requiring GP/GO/GN; none appear on any SV1 in the 837P. Chart note confirms PT services → GP is the correct modifier. Medicare MB claim: submit new original CLM05-3=1 with GP on every line.

root_cause.explanation: All five lines denied CO-4/N822. No GP/GO/GN modifier on any SV1 in the 837P. CPTs 97110, 97140, 97530 are always-therapy codes requiring a therapy discipline modifier; chart note confirms PT plan of care.

next_action.detail: Add modifier GP to all five SV1 lines and resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8). Do not use frequency 7 or appeal — CO-4/N822 is unprocessable with no appeal rights. Watch the 1-year filing clock from DOS 2026-06-01.

evidence.fact: All five SVC lines carry CAS*CO*4 + LQ*HE*N822; $0 paid on each.
No GP/GO/GN modifier present on any SV1 segment for 97110, 97140, or 97530.
evidence.locator: SV1*HC:97110, SV1*HC:97140, SV1*HC:97530 — modifier field empty

evidence.fact: Services are physical therapy under a PT plan of care → GP modifier required.
Filing indicator MB (Medicare Part B) → new original CLM05-3=1 required; frequency 7 not accepted on Part B.

citations.rule: CO-4 + N822 on always-therapy CPTs = returned unprocessable; remedy is new original claim with GP/GO/GN appended, not appeal or frequency 7.
Medicare Part B does not accept CLM05-3=7; use new original (1) for unprocessable/returned claims.
